statements:
CREATE TABLE glossary_revisions (
	document_id VARCHAR(80), 
	source_language VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_language VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent_id VARCHAR(80), 
	entries JSONB NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE translation_memory (
	document_id VARCHAR(80), 
	independent BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	source_language VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_language VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	target_inline JSONB NOT NULL, 
	context_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE candidates (
	draft_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(80), 
	base JSONB NOT NULL, 
	results JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES translation_drafts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE issue_resolutions (
	draft_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	issue_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES translation_drafts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_records (
	draft_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	block_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	segment_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES translation_drafts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE reading_positions (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	locale VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	block_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	"offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id, locale, artifact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)

CREATE TABLE search_entries (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	edition_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	locale VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	block_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	source_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	target_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(edition_id) REFERENCES editions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)
